name: Galapagos Grand Majestic

seo.title: Grand Majestic Galapagos Charter Yacht | James Wild & Co
seo.description: Royal Galapagos' Grand Majestic: a 25-knot, 16-guest charter yacht with a 39 sq m master suite. Whole-boat charters from US$44,450. 2026 and 2027 rates.

tagline: A fast, 16-guest yacht built for private charters.
answer: Galapagos Grand Majestic is a 39-metre aluminium yacht built in 2018, which Royal Galapagos says is designed for exclusive high-end private charters. She carries 16 guests in 7 staterooms and a 39-square-metre master suite, with 9 crew and a bilingual naturalist guide, and cruises at up to 25 knots. A whole-boat charter costs US$44,450 for 4 days to US$106,450 for 8 days in 2027.

overview: Grand Majestic is a 39-metre yacht built in 2018 in aluminium and fibre-reinforced polymer. Royal Galapagos, an Ecuadorian operator since 2012, calls her the only modern charter yacht cruising the Galapagos, specifically designed for exclusive high-end private charters, with fast navigation between islands.

She sleeps 16. The Master Suite on the Main Deck is 39 square metres with his and hers bathrooms; one stateroom shares the Main Deck and six are on the Lower Deck, from 12 to 17 square metres. All have private bathrooms, hot water and air conditioning. The sundeck has a jacuzzi and al fresco dining, with a lounge and internet.

Two 8-day loops start and end at San Cristobal: A covers Espanola, Floreana, the Santa Cruz highlands, Genovesa and Rabida; B covers North Seymour, Bartolome, western Isabela, Fernandina and Santiago. Four and five-day sections are cut from week A.
why: Built for one group: book the whole yacht for 16 at a published charter price, with a master suite for the hosts.
At 25 knots she is the fastest boat in this set, and both 8-day weeks begin and end at San Cristobal, which keeps flights simple for a charter group.

faqs: How much does it cost to charter Grand Majestic?
Royal Galapagos publishes 2027 whole-yacht prices of US$44,450 for 4 days, US$68,450 for 5 days and US$106,450 for 8 days. Flights, park fees and tips are extra.
How many guests can she take?
Sixteen, in a master suite and seven staterooms, with nine crew and a bilingual naturalist guide.
Can I book a single cabin?
Royal Galapagos also publishes per person rates, from US$3,145 in a stateroom for 4 days, but describes her as designed for private charters.
Royal Galapagos lists a speed of 25 knots, which it says allows fast navigation between islands.
What is the master suite like?
It is 39 square metres on the Main Deck, with his and hers bathrooms and binoculars.
Both 8-day weeks start and end at San Cristobal. The 5-day section starts at Baltra and the 4-day section ends there.
Week A covers Espanola, Floreana, the Santa Cruz highlands, Genovesa and Rabida. Week B covers North Seymour, Bartolome, western Isabela, Fernandina and Santiago.
Can children come on a charter?
Royal Galapagos does not publish a minimum age. Under 15s get 20% off the per person rate when sharing with one full-paying adult.
